title: P0.2 Authenticated Password Change UI

permissions.reason: Self-service password change is available to an authenticated identity; Core verifies the current credential and owns credential authorization, so no FAIR CRM product RBAC permission is introduced.

database.reason: The security UI introduces no FAIR CRM persistence.

migration.reason: No FAIR CRM schema or permission-catalog change is required.

permissions.reason: Authenticated self-service credential change is Core-owned and does not introduce a FAIR CRM product permission.

backend.reason: The authenticated password-change bridge route was delivered in CRM-BE-02.

api.reason: This phase consumes the already-delivered FAIR CRM password-change bridge contract.

tenant_isolation.reason: No product data or organization-owned resource identifier is read or mutated by this UI.

audit.reason: Credential-change audit evidence is emitted by Core; FAIR CRM adds no independent audit stream.

ui_permissions.reason: The security action is identity self-service rather than product RBAC; authentication remains mandatory.

menu.reason: The entry is an account action in the existing user dropdown, not the permission-gated application navigation menu.

backend_tests.reason: Backend bridge behavior was certified in CRM-BE-02 and backend code is unchanged here.

notes: The route requires a real access token. FAIR CRM sends current/new password only through the thin bridge; confirmation is local UX only and Core remains authoritative for password policy/current-password verification/credential mutation. On success Core revokes prior sessions, the FAIR CRM bridge clears the refresh cookie, and the UI clears local access/session state before returning to login.
